Mark Delaney founded the Company in {{company.founded}} and owns it. It employs {{hc.total}} people besides the owner, {{hc.field}} in the field, and has {{kpi.maintenance_members}} maintenance-agreement members (1). FY2025 revenue of {{rev.latest}} was {{line.residential.share0.FY2025}} residential, {{line.commercial.share0.FY2025}} commercial and {{line.maintenance.share0.FY2025}} maintenance agreements. s10_1.title: The owner is selling the operating assets, with up to {{owner.transitionMonths}} months of transition and a target exit within 12 months
s10_1.transaction: Mark Delaney, the founder and owner, is offering the operating assets of Ridgeline Comfort Services LLC; he prefers an asset sale (1). He is retiring at {{owner.age}} and wants a clean exit within 12 months. He is open to a buyer keeping the Ridgeline name and all {{hc.total}} employees. Offers should assume an asset purchase in which the Seller keeps cash, receivables and payables and repays debt at closing.
s10_1.transition: The owner will stay up to {{owner.transitionMonths}} months after closing and introduce the commercial accounts (1). Lisa Tran, operations manager and with the Company {{mgmt.lisa.tenure}}, runs dispatch and day-to-day scheduling and is expected to stay. The {{hc.field}} field employees are paid hourly plus spiff commissions on maintenance agreements, with no union.
s10_1.premises: The Company leases an {{kpi.shop_size}} shop and office on Maple Ave from an unrelated landlord; the lease runs through 2029 with a five-year renewal option (1). The fleet is {{kpi.fleet_service_vans}} service vans and {{kpi.fleet_install_trucks}} install trucks, owned and financed with vehicle loans. ServiceTitan runs dispatch, invoicing and memberships, and QuickBooks Online the books.
s10_1.process: We will invite qualified buyers who have signed a confidentiality agreement to an introductory call and then a management meeting, on the timetable on {{page:S10.2}}. All inquiries should be directed to AMB Advisory, not to the Seller or its employees.

open_questions: Maintenance-agreement renewal rate (about 82%) and offer rate (about 35% of service calls) are the owner's estimates: confirm both against ServiceTitan membership reports and give the measurement period.
The 1,450 member count is as of the intake call (September 2026): confirm the count at Dec-25 so revenue per member uses matching periods.
Market salary of about $95,000 for a replacement general manager is the owner's estimate: confirm the basis (survey, local postings or a recent hire).
Plumbing service (added in 2019): which revenue line records it and its FY2025 revenue.
Lead sources: share of FY2025 leads from referrals, Google reviews and paid channels, to support the marketing lever.
Vehicle loans: confirm whether the 20 vehicles transfer free of liens with the loans repaid by the Seller at closing.
